about.title: About
about.shortBio: I'm Diyorbek — a full stack developer who writes both the interface and the server side of web applications.
about.longBio: Interfaces in React and Next.js, servers in Node.js and Django, Telegram bots in Python. My work includes a psychological screening system, an online olympiad bot and a SaaS platform for hotels.
about.workStyle: I carry a project whole rather than a slice of it — from the database schema to the screen the user sees. Nothing falls between the layers that way.
about.partnersSubtitle: The team I build projects with

about.quote: The best way to predict the future is to build it.
